Politics · India

Protests Erupt in Jammu and Pakistan-Administered Kashmir

Protests have occurred in Jammu and Pakistan-administered Kashmir (PoK). In Jammu, refugees from PoK demonstrated, urging the Indian government to reclaim the territory. In PoK, protests against the Pakistani government and military have intensified over issues including basic amenities, with reports of civilian deaths. Separately, opposition MPs staged a protest outside India's Parliament, highlighting alleged embezzlement of Ram Temple donations and student protests.
